boundaries.chat: Deterministic provider-neutral planner; external model gateway may augment but not bypass verification
boundaries.database: SQLAlchemy-backed; thread-safe shared-memory SQLite development fixture, PostgreSQL production target
boundaries.identity: Built-in Argon2id and signed tokens; external OIDC/SAML adapter remains a production extension
boundaries.secrets: AES-256-GCM reference provider; production KMS/HSM key custody required

claim_boundary: Small deterministic functional/adversarial fixture only; not a load, penetration, multi-process, availability, or throughput benchmark.
